title: Review of phase_membrane_damage_mature (L4a[L3] repair): Supported on 3 fresh compact targets with same-seed undamaged twins; repair is curvature flow (by construction)
summary: Re-ran phase_membrane from noise on seeds 13-16 with --damage 120:0.5:rim and a same-seed undamaged twin for each. On the three seeds where labkit chose a mature compact target (14, 15, 16; 25-29% of matter erased), the wall and the L link ring close within 100 time units (ring_L_after_cut.png), the cut cell regains 0.93-0.96 (s14), 0.88-0.95 (s15) and 0.94 (s16) of its twin's area within 600-1500 time units, and it then shares the twin's fate (division on s14 and s15, loss on s16; twin_cmp_seed1*.png). Seed 13's target was a non-compact fallback (4.3x median, aspect 1.67): its wall also closed but it split earlier than its twin, so it does not count. Repair is automatic curvature flow, so R is marked by construction; recovery always lags the twin slightly and 'mature' is weak because cells grow continuously.

observations.I: rerun/seed14/sheet.png: ~17-21 discrete walled cells at t=6000
observations.B: rerun/seed14/FACTS.md: L link rim/core 1.75, rim/outside 4.98, 84/97 membrane-like; ring_L_after_cut.png
observations.R: twin_cmp_seed14.png: area ratio to twin 0.74 (t=6100), 0.85 (6400), 0.93 (6600), 0.96 (7100); twin_cmp_seed15.png 0.80 -> 0.95; twin_cmp_seed16.png 0.81 -> 0.94; ring_L_after_cut.png ring closed by t=6100-6250 on all three

seeds_run.result: target not mature-compact (fallback-largest); wall closed, split earlier than twin; not counted

controls_run.R: twin/seed14, twin/seed15, twin/seed16 (same seed, no damage), compared crop by crop in twin_cmp_seed1*.png

verdicts.limitation: Cuts were 25-29% (labkit's rim mask on small cells), not the claimed 41%; the cut cell lags its twin by 5-15% in area for 1000+ time units; closure is Allen-Cahn curvature flow, so it holds by construction; no dt/2 or resolution check; 'mature' is loose since cells grow continuously.
